steps.npc: Good day, friend. I hope that you are well.
This land has seen better days, but I have no doubt that Father Sugadinti will guide us into making it a new paradise.
Greetings. It is still early days, but I hope you are already starting to see the results of Father Sugadinti's work here.

steps.player: Hello. How are you finding life here in Morytania?

steps.npc: Most pleasing. Our lives are no longer in constant danger, and we are now finally able to help bring about Father Sugadinti's vision for the future.

steps.player: Well, I'm glad it's going well for you.

steps.npc: Greetings, my friend. It is good to see you.
Hello there, friend. May Father Sugadinti guide you.
